intel.title: Intelligence
intel.noNewSuggestions: No new suggestions. NORA scans every time you open this panel.
intel.connectPrompt: Connect Telegram or Gmail so NORA can automatically detect events, deadlines, and reservations.
aiHub.title: AI Hub
aiHub.assistantDesc: General conversations, planning and intelligent help.
ob.meetDesc: Connect your inbox and messaging apps. NORA will automatically detect appointments, deadlines, and reservations — and ask before adding anything to your planner.
ob.connectGmailDesc: NORA reads your recent emails to detect reservations, flight confirmations, deadlines, and more — and surfaces them as suggestions for you to approve.
ob.gmailPrivacy: 🔒 NORA only reads emails — never sends, modifies, or deletes anything. You can disconnect at any time.
ob.connectTelegramDesc: NORA reads your recent messages automatically and surfaces appointments, deadlines, and reservations — you just review and approve.
ob.enterPhone: Enter your Telegram phone number. NORA will send you a verification code via Telegram.
ob.phoneHint: Include country code, e.g. +49 for Germany
ob.codeSentTo: Check your Telegram app — a code was just sent to {{phone}}.
ob.twoFaDesc: Your account has two-step verification enabled. Enter your Telegram cloud password.
ob.errSendCode: Could not send code. Check the phone number format (+1234567890).
ob.errWrongCode: Incorrect code. Check your Telegram app.
ob.doneDesc: I'll monitor your connected sources and surface suggestions whenever I find something worth your attention. You'll always review before anything is added.
